column13: A Succint one line game comment to summarise that game
A dramatic draw as Essendon kicked an astonishingly inaccurate 7.27 (69) to tie with Melbourne on 10.9 (69).
Melbourne recalled 33-year-old Jack Mueller who booted six goals to comfortably defeat Essendon in the replay.
